title: Beatrix and the Crown
author: Hazel Iversen
blurb: Odile Brightwater, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
